verdict.rationale: Amplitude ships a documented MCP server that lets AI tools (Claude, Cursor, etc.) query behavioral data and get answers, and a Dashboard REST API that returns existing dashboard graph data as JSON — but nothing in the evidence shows an API or MCP action that creates or configures a new dashboard/chart end-to-end (only data export from dashboards that already exist). missing for 10: an explicit API/MCP capability to create or configure dashboard widgets/charts programmatically, and a hands-on/independent example of an agent actually building a dashboard this way.
